baseline: 25 concurrent logins -> 10-43 second latency / timeouts (bcrypt CPU contention)

bottleneck.cause: Synchronous bcrypt.checkpw (cost=12, 188ms per call) running on asyncio event loop
bottleneck.impact: 25+ concurrent logins block event loop for 10-43s, starving all other endpoints

bcrypt_config.security_note: OWASP recommends cost >= 10; cost=12 is appropriate and not changed

changes.change: Added verify_password_async() — async wrapper using loop.run_in_executor(None, verify_password, ...)
Changed import from verify_password to verify_password_async; updated authenticate() to await verify_password_async()

baseline_comparison.before: 25 concurrent logins -> 10-43s latency / timeouts, health endpoint starved
baseline_comparison.after: 25 concurrent logins -> 5.83s wall, all succeed, health p99=44ms
baseline_comparison.improvement: Event loop no longer blocked; health endpoint responsive during login load
